opening_activity: sorting mismatched hand tools back onto a wall-mounted tool rack after a community repair session while another volunteer works at the neighboring bench
opening_environment: a modest shared repair space with wooden benches, hanging hand tools, small parts trays, task lamps, and another volunteer working within easy view
topic_visual_link: A nearby volunteer visibly yawns while the host is sorting tools, and moments later the host's own jaw begins opening despite his effort to keep working.
opening_visual_proof: At frame zero the host is placing a wrench onto the rack while a volunteer at the adjacent bench gives a large unmistakable yawn directly within his peripheral view.
curiosity_trigger: He catches the neighboring yawn, then feels his own mouth and jaw involuntarily starting the same motion.
reaction: He suppresses the emerging yawn, pauses with a tool still in hand, and gives the other volunteer a tired, skeptical sideways glance.
book_retrieval: He sets the tool down and reaches to the end of the workbench for a worn reference book already resting beside the parts trays.
world_style_hint: textured graphite-and-pencil-sketch repair workshop with loose construction lines, paper grain, soft smudged shading, and clearly drawn hand tools
reason: The shared workshop makes tool sorting natural for the script while placing another person close enough for a plainly visible yawn to trigger the host's restrained, immediately understandable contagious-yawning reaction.
